data.name: Gutam
data.gender_notes: Gutam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gutam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gudh’ which means 'that which is hidden'. The name Gutam is a masculine name and is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gudhatma’, which means 'one who holds knowledge within himself'. This name symbolizes wisdom and knowledge that is deeply rooted within an individual. The name Gutam carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gutam usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of deep knowledge and wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gutam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
